amount_is_base_true.meaning: the FOK order is submitted with amountIsBase set to true

amount_not_divisible_by_lot.meaning: the order amount is not divisible by the lot size (report gives no numeric lot size or amount)

fok_fill_reverted.meaning: the FOK fill order reverts because a rounded-off remainder (less than one lot) is left unfilled
fok_fill_reverted.checkpoint: after CLOB fill matching of the FOK order

assumptions: The FOK order is processed by the CLOB matching flow (_matchIncomingOrder, _matchIncomingBid, _processFillBidOrder).
The rounded-off remainder is the amount left unfilled that is less than one lot of base.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete lot size or order amount, so the divisibility relation is represented only by the report-stated qualitative condition.

limitations: Only the revert-on-rounded-input impact is formalized; other listed impacts are handled in separate passes.
The dust-tolerance threshold is qualitative in the report; numeric binding is deferred to code-level analysis.
